import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "font.size": 10, "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "text.color": "#263238", "axes.labelcolor": "#263238", "xtick.color": "#657786", "ytick.color": "#657786", "svg.fonttype": "none", "lines.linewidth": 1.6, })
n = np.arange(4) vectors = np.array([ [1, 1, 1, 1], [1, 0, -1, 0], [0, 1, 0, -1], [1, -1, 1, -1], ], dtype=float)
if not np.allclose(vectors @ vectors.T, np.diag([4, 2, 2, 4])): raise ValueError("The supplied vectors must form an orthogonal basis of R^4.")
colors = ["#33658A", "#2A9D8F", "#D4A72C", "#9273B5"] names = [ "DC component", "Fundamental cosine", "Fundamental sine", "Nyquist frequency cosine", ] formulas = [ r"$c_0(n)=\cos(0\cdot 2\pi n/4)$", r"$c_1(n)=\cos(1\cdot 2\pi n/4)$", r"$s_1(n)=\sin(1\cdot 2\pi n/4)$", r"$c_2(n)=\cos(2\cdot 2\pi n/4)$", ] vector_labels = [ r"$[1,\ 1,\ 1,\ 1]^{\mathsf{T}}$", r"$[1,\ 0,\ {-1},\ 0]^{\mathsf{T}}$", r"$[0,\ 1,\ 0,\ {-1}]^{\mathsf{T}}$", r"$[1,\ {-1},\ 1,\ {-1}]^{\mathsf{T}}$", ] functions = [ lambda x: np.ones_like(x), lambda x: np.cos(2 * np.pi * x / 4), lambda x: np.sin(2 * np.pi * x / 4), lambda x: np.cos(2 * 2 * np.pi * x / 4), ]
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(10, 4.3), dpi=100) fig.text( 0.5, 0.958, r"A discrete sine–cosine basis in $\mathbb{R}^{4}$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=17, weight="semibold", ) fig.text( 0.5, 0.895, r"$N=4$ equally spaced samples • $n=0,1,2,3$ • Unnormalized basis vectors", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=10, color="#657786", )
lefts = [0.066, 0.309, 0.552, 0.795] width = 0.181 x = np.linspace(0, 3, 601)
for i, (left, color) in enumerate(zip(lefts, colors)): center = left + width / 2 fig.text( center, 0.816, names[i], ha="center", va="center", color=color, fontsize=10.3, weight="semibold", ) fig.text( center, 0.758, formulas[i], ha="center", va="center", fontsize=10.5, ) fig.text( center, 0.700, vector_labels[i], ha="center", va="center", fontsize=11.5, color=color, )
ax = fig.add_axes([left, 0.343, width, 0.288]) ax.axhline(0, color="#CAD2D6", linewidth=0.9, zorder=0) ax.plot( x, functions[i](x), color=color, linewidth=1.8, linestyle=(0, (1.1, 2.2)), alpha=0.57, zorder=1, dash_capstyle="round", ) ax.vlines(n, 0, vectors[i], color=color, linewidth=1.8, zorder=2) ax.scatter( n, vectors[i], s=34, color=color, edgecolor="white", linewidth=0.7, zorder=3, ) ax.set_xlim(-0.18, 3.18) ax.set_ylim(-1.25, 1.25) ax.set_xticks(n) ax.set_yticks([-1, 0, 1]) ax.tick_params(axis="both", labelsize=9, length=0, pad=5) ax.set_xlabel(r"Sample index $n$", fontsize=9, labelpad=5) for spine in ax.spines.values(): spine.set_visible(False)
fig.text( 0.017, 0.487, "Amplitude (dimensionless)", rotation=90, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=9, color="#657786", )
legend_handles = [ Line2D( [], [], color="#657786", marker="o", linestyle="none", markersize=5, label="Discrete samples", ), Line2D( [], [], color="#657786", linestyle=(0, (1.1, 2.2)), linewidth=1.7, label="Continuous trigonometric guide", ), ] fig.legend( handles=legend_handles, loc="center", bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.222), ncol=2, frameon=False, fontsize=8.8, handlelength=2.6, columnspacing=2.7, labelcolor="#657786", )
fig.text( 0.5, 0.155, r"$\langle c_0,c_1\rangle=0" r"\qquad \langle c_0,s_1\rangle=0" r"\qquad \langle c_0,c_2\rangle=0$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=10.5, ) fig.text( 0.5, 0.108, r"$\langle c_1,s_1\rangle=0" r"\qquad \langle c_1,c_2\rangle=0" r"\qquad \langle s_1,c_2\rangle=0$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=10.5, ) fig.text( 0.5, 0.043, r"All 4 vectors are mutually orthogonal in $\mathbb{R}^{4}$!", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=11.5, weight="semibold", )
